sovereign_country.strategic_role: 支持全中文章程、传统华人客群离岸家族信托常驻地

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Retail Sale via Internet - DTC Brand Webstore

meta_jurisdiction_context.sovereign_country_en: Independent State of Samoa (Malo Sa'oloto Tuto'atasi o Samoa)
meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Samoa — unitary national jurisdiction with no sub-state incorporation, tax or regulatory distinction
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid — statutory English Common Law heritage applied uniformly, with Samoan customary law (fa'a Samoa) recognized in land-holding and personal-status matters; non-federal, unitary state
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: PACER Plus (Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus), in force 13 December 2020 — trade and investment facilitation framework binding Samoa with Australia, New Zealand and Pacific Island Forum members
World Trade Organization membership — Samoa acceded on 10 November 2011, with GATT 1994 and GATS commitments applicable
Samoa–EU ACP/Cotonou successor arrangement — trade preference and development cooperation context

No comprehensive bilateral double-taxation agreement or standalone bilateral investment treaty with a major capital-exporting state is currently in active force; foreign-investor protection derives from Samoa's domestic foreign investment and establishment statutes administered by the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour and from general law

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1987 (as amended), ss. 5-8 (incorporation), s. 10 (memorandum), s. 46 (registered office), s. 53 (directors and secretary); Companies Act 2001 for supplemental governance rules
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA), Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form IC-1 Application for Incorporation as an International Company; Memorandum and Articles of Association
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; authorized capital may be denominated in any currency; no escrow or bank deposit requirement
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the Company subscribe for 100 ordinary shares of US$1 each, issued to the initial subscriber for cash at par. FURTHER RESOLVED that the registered office of the Company be established at the office of the licensed registered agent in Apia, Samoa, and such agent be authorized to act as the Company's registered agent. FURTHER RESOLVED that [Name] be appointed as sole director and [Name] as secretary, each to hold office until removed by resolution. The director and secretary are jointly empowered to open bank accounts, execute Shopify seller agreements, and file all necessary regulatory declarations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) online reservation portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the proposed company name (ended with 'Limited' or 'Ltd') via the SIFA e-service or a licensed registered agent; ensure the name is not identical to an existing international company, domestic company, or protected trademark in Samoa. Receive a reservation confirmation valid for 30 days.
required_dossiers: Certificate of due diligence from registered agent
Identity and proof of address for proposed subscriber
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused, file an appeal with the Registrar for a name review, or amend the proposed name and resubmit within the reservation window.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Draft constitutional documents and submit incorporation application
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Memorandum and Articles of Association, confirming the liability clause, share capital, director and secretary details, and the registered agent in Samoa. Physically or electronically lodge Form IC-1 together with the M&A and the name reservation voucher at the SIFA Registry counter in Apia or through the registered agent's secure channel. Pay the prescribed filing fee by bank draft or wire transfer.
required_dossiers: Consent to act from each director and secretary
Registered agent consent form and registered office address in Samoa
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry issues a requisition for clarification, the applicant or agent must file a written response within 14 days explaining or amending the relevant provision; re-lodge the corrected document and pay any applicable resubmission fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and company seal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the Registrar issues a Certificate of Incorporation, the evidence of legal existence, and records the date of incorporation. The company may adopt a common seal, though affixation is optional under Samoan law unless stated in the M&A. Obtain certified extract of registration from the Registrar.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate is not issued within the SLA, the applicant may apply to the Registrar for a status inquiry; persistent delay may be escalated to the Chief Executive Officer of SIFA.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-incorporation governance documentation and tax-registry notification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority; Ministry for Revenue
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open the company's corporate records book, record the first board resolution, register share allotments, and issue share certificates. File an information return with SIFA confirming the registered office and directors. If relevant, notify the Samoa Ministry for Revenue for tax file number and confirm international company exemption status.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax file number cannot be issued because of documentary insufficiency, submit the certified True Copy of the Certificate of Incorporation and a fully executed Form TIN-100 to correct the application.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable – online retail (ISIC 4791) is not classified as industrial activity under Samoa's Investment Promotion Act
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No manufacturing or operational license required; only general business registration through the Samoa International Finance Authority and Ministry of Revenue

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – no physical processing, manufacturing, or waste generation; pure DTC webstore activity
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable; zero on-site discharge, zero volatile organic compound emissions, zero wastewater; if ancillary warehouse use later arises, threshold under the Regulations (e.g. >50 m3/day effluent) would trigger a Registration EIA

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification not required for virtual office. If a commercial premises or fulfilment centre is occupied, a Certificate of Fire Safety must be obtained from Samoa Fire and Emergency Services Authority (SFESA) and a structural load inspection from Ministry of Works, Transport and Infrastructure (MWTI) is advised for server/warehouse equipment.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Samoa Revenue Authority (SRA), successor to the Ministry for Revenue; official e-services portal: https://sra.gov.ws
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign or offshore entity applies to the SRA for a Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) on the prescribed Form TR-1 (Application for Registration of Taxpayer), accompanied by a certified certificate of incorporation (for an International Company, the Certificate of Registration issued by the Registrar of International Companies, MCIL), memorandum and articles, proof of registered office in Samoa, and identification of directors/shareholders. The SRA issues the TIN within 3-5 business days; a non-resident IC with no Samoan business activity and no VAGST/customs/employer obligations is not required to hold a TIN for its offshore DTC e-commerce activity.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box election or hybrid-mismatch election exists in Samoa. An International Company is automatically exempt from Samoan income tax and is non-resident unless it carries on business in Samoa; if it transacts in Samoa it loses the exemption and must convert/re-register as an ordinary company under the Companies Act 2001 (triggering the 27% corporate income tax and VAGST). A VAGST group registration election is available for affiliated companies, but group consolidation for income tax is not available to ICs.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Goods and Services Tax (VAGST)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: WST 100,000 of taxable supplies in any 12-month period (voluntary registration permitted below threshold)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, digital stamping, or government API mandate exists in Samoa; the SRA e-Services portal receives VAGST returns and invoice-level data on a post-transaction filing basis. Registered suppliers must issue serially numbered VAGST tax invoices showing the supplier's TIN, date, description, taxable value in Samoan Tālā, and 15% output tax, and all supporting records must be retained for 7 years.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies to goods physically exported from Samoa to a non-resident, to services supplied directly to a non-resident outside Samoa ('exported services'), and to supplies of internationally traded digital/remote services where the DTC customer is a non-resident. A VAGST-registered IC may claim 0% where the supply contract, delivery, performance, and payment evidence establish that supply is made to a non-resident; offshore income of an International Company is entirely outside the Samoan tax base and therefore not subject to VAGST.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical export
Commercial invoice and VAGST tax invoice
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank SWIFT credit evidence showing foreign-source payment
Delivery/performance evidence (courier proof, non-resident billing and IP-country address) for DTC digital/remote supplies
Copy of the International Company registration certificate supporting the exempt-entity file
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: SRA may raise an assessment within 3 years (7 years in cases of evasion), reclassify domestic supplies at 15%, and claw back input tax refunds with statutory interest at 2% per month on late amounts. Civil shortfall penalties run up to 20% (or 150% for intentional evasion); criminal liability for fraudulent export claims and false customs declarations attracts fines of up to WST 100,000 (or up to three times the tax evaded) and imprisonment for up to 7 years.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (CBS), established under the Central Bank Act 1984, which administers the Exchange Control Act 1976 and the Exchange Control Regulations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Samoan tālā (WST) is a managed-float currency with limited offshore convertibility. Samoa maintains exchange controls distinguishing current-account transactions (generally liberalised and delegated to authorized commercial banks) from capital-account transactions (dividend repatriation, shareholder loan repayments, equity injections) that require prior CBS approval or a no-objection certificate. For the non-resident International Company ('IC') engaged in DTC e-commerce outside Samoa, convertibility is effectively unrestricted if all receipts and disbursements are held in designated foreign-currency accounts; remittances of sales revenue from overseas payment processors to WST accounts are freely exchangeable to USD within commercial bank dealing limits. Profit remittance hurdles are moderate: audited financial statements, tax clearance, CBS exchange-control approval, and confirmation that the IC does not derive Samoan-source income.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under CBS exchange-control regulations, export receipts from physical goods shipped from Samoa must be repatriated within 90 days of shipment; a percentage may be required to be converted into WST at a licensed bank if the exporter is a Samoan resident. A Samoan International Company whose Shopify-branded e-commerce sales originate outside Samoa and are settled through PayPal, Stripe, or Shopify Payments is not treated as a Samoan exporter for surrender purposes; the IC may retain 100% of foreign-currency receipts in an approved offshore USD/EUR/GBP clearing account, provided the bank classifies the account as a non-resident or offshore IC account and the CBS grants a standing exemption.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of South Pacific (BSP) Limited – Samoa Branch

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low feasibility. Samoa has no dedicated electronic-money institution (EMI) licensing regime, and CBS does not regulate offshore digital payment providers. Foreign EMIs such as Wise, Airwallex, and Revolut cannot open settlement accounts at Samoan banks and will not provide multi-currency IBANs to a Samoan IC unless the IC first obtains a bank account in an accepted jurisdiction; even then, such providers typically reject countries appearing on FATF grey lists. The primary permissible fintech rails are the payment gateways themselves (Shopify Payments, PayPal, Stripe), which operate as card acquirers and remit funds in USD/EUR via SWIFT/ACH; they are not substitutes for Samoan banking relationships.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: CBS-supervised banks require face-to-face verification for any director or UBO with a high-risk nationality, for companies lacking a substantive local office, and for WST-denominated accounts. Remote opening is permitted only after a licensed Samoan registered agent or attorney certifies corporate documents and acts as introducer; a video-conference interview with the compliance officer is mandatory. For a foreign-owned IC with clean KYC and an established Shopify/DTC profile, at least one director must physically attend a brief interview at the bank's Apia branch, or the bank may waive this after enhanced electronic verification and a two-director resolution.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: The IC is a tax-exempt offshore company with nominee shareholders and no physical employment or premises in Samoa, indicating economic-substance risk.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified copy of the International Company Register extract; authorised share register; UBO and director questionnaires; trust deed or nominee declaration; registered office and registered agent letter confirming compliance with the International Companies Act 1987; annual licence fee receipt; evidence of management performed by a Samoan licensed trustee or attorney.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unusual e-commerce transaction pattern with high chargeback ratios and rapid conversion from customer sales to third-party supplier payouts, potentially indicating payment laundering.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed business plan and ISIC 4791 store operating model; Shopify/PayPal/Stripe settlement statements for the last 12 months; payment processor KYC documentation; chargeback dispute log and refund policy; executed supplier agreements; IP-country geolocation sales report confirming no US/OFAC-sanctioned jurisdictions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inbound investment from an offshore holding company resident in a FATF grey-listed jurisdiction, raising source-of-funds concerns.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bank-reference letter from the remitting institution confirming the source of funds; audited accounts of the parent company; sworn declaration of no tax evasion; CBS exchange-control approval for the capital injection; copy of the debanked or refused-account history if applicable; evidence of genuine economic activity in the DTC webstore including transaction listings and fulfilment contracts.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound share-capital or shareholder-loan funds must be routed via SWIFT MT103 from a qualifying bank to the IC's USD or EUR operational account at an authorised Samoan commercial bank. The wire must use standard purpose code G010 (equity injection) or G101 (intercompany loan) and be supported by the board resolution and a CBS exchange-control approval for non-resident foreign investment. The originating bank must be an approved financial institution with a valid AML/CFT relationship; funds may be sequestered until the IC provides a notarised share certificate, a director confirmation letter, and the CBS mandatory disclosure of the ultimate beneficial owner. If the remittance is made to a WST account, the bank will automatically convert to WST at the prevailing CBS reference rate and issue an exchange-control clearance slip to enable future profit repatriation.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Clearing rails for supplier and fulfilment payments are primarily SWIFT MT103 wire transfers for single transactions under US$100,000, and commercial letters of credit (MT700) for high-value inventory procurement. The bank will require the underlying sales invoice, packing list, pro-forma invoice, and a signed trade-purpose declaration. Payments to Shopify Payments, PayPal, and Stripe settlement entities (e.g., Stripe Treasury accounts) must be recorded as 'intercompany settlement' with purpose code G105; to avoid delays, the end destination must not be a high-risk jurisdiction or a private virtual-asset service provider. For supplier disbursements in EU and GBP, IC can request a multi-currency clearing account at the same Samoan bank, or use the bank's currency conversion desk for MT103 settlements.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: FX forward contracts up to 12 months for USD/EUR and GBP/USD, underlying a confirmed sales or procurement flow, executed through a CBS-licensed commercial bank in Samoa.
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on USD/WST transacted with an offshore investment-grade bank, provided the hedge is recorded in the IC's internal treasury policy and is not speculative.

Cross-currency interest-free swaps between USD and EUR (principal exchange only) under a bilateral ISDA or CSA, subject to CBS exchange-control notification and only if the counterparty is a Schedule A bank in an OECD jurisdiction.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) / Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour, Apia, Samoa
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due on each anniversary of incorporation; remittance through the registered agent within 30 days after the anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-payment attracts late-payment penalties, suspension of registration status, and eventual administrative strike-off after notice by the Registrar. Directors and the registered agent may also be subject to disqualification and personal liability for continuing to act while the company is delinquent.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return / Confirmation Statement of International Company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA), Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour, Apia, Samoa
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filed by the registered agent within 30 calendar days after each anniversary of registration, regardless of the company's accounting reference date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing may incur a fixed late-filing penalty plus a daily penalty until filed. Persistent failure to file is a ground for the Registrar to initiate deregistration or strike-off, and may render the company unable to lawfully carry on business.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) and Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit while acting through the appointed registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual confirmation due with the anniversary renewal, or within 14 days of any shareholder transfer or beneficial owner change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain or confirm beneficial ownership records may expose the company and its registered agent to administrative fines, civil penalties, and criminal liability under Samoa's Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Financing of Terrorism Act. The Registrar may also refuse renewal or strike off the company.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A Samoa International Company is exempt from compulsory independent audit unless it holds a regulated financial services license, conducts banking or insurance business, or is otherwise expressly required by a sectoral law or by the company's own charter. Voluntary audit may be adopted by shareholder resolution.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Companies are required to keep financial records adequate to explain transactions and financial position. Financial statements may be prepared using IFRS or an equivalent recognized accounting framework; any appointed auditor must conduct the audit in accordance with International Standards on Auditing.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The registered agent must keep current beneficial ownership records and update them immediately upon any transfer of shares or change in ultimate ownership. At each annual renewal, the agent must provide a written confirmation of beneficial ownership to the Registrar of International Companies; the confirmation is kept on a confidential, non-public basis and does not require public filing of shareholder identities.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book of Shareholder and Director Resolutions

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: US$300–US$700 per annum for registered office and licensed registered agent services in Samoa
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: US$0 where no statutory audit is required; US$1,200–US$5,000 per annum if a voluntary independent audit is appointed for the DTC brand entity

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 27% (standard Samoan corporate income tax rate under the Income Tax Act 2015)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Samoa International Companies (ICs) regulated under the International Companies Act 1987 operate in a statutory tax-exempt zone: all offshore-derived income, including global Shopify DTC e-commerce revenue, is exempt from Samoan corporate income tax. Additional reliefs include zero capital gains tax, zero stamp duty on offshore instruments, no branch remittance tax, and a reduced small-company concessionary rate for qualifying domestic operators. The effective tax rate for a fully compliant offshore-only IC is 0%.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: IC Annual Return (Form 7 under the International Companies Act 1987) — filed with the Registrar of International Companies through the Samoa Companies Online Registry (SCOR); filed concurrently with the Annual Government Fee (AGF) computation and the Economic Substance declaration.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within 6 months of the incorporation anniversary; the Annual Government Fee is payable by each 12-month incorporation anniversary regardless of filing. A substituted fiscal year-end aligned to the DTC brand's global e-commerce accounting calendar may be adopted where approved by the Registrar.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Company name and IC registration number as recorded in the International Companies Register.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Verify the exact registered legal name matches the Shopify seller entity and all payment-rail account holders (Shopify Payments, PayPal, Stripe).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office address in Samoa, which must be a licensed registered agent's office.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Appoint a Samoan licensed registered agent and accurately state the statutory address; a PO Box alone is insufficient for economic substance purposes.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Register of directors and shareholders, including beneficial ownership details under the Beneficial Ownership Act 2020.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Disclose all ultimate beneficial owners with full legal names, passport details, residential addresses, and nationality; nominee-shareholder concealment is an AML trigger.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Principal business activities and place of business description.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Describe 'online retail sale of consumer goods via webstore (ISIC 4791)' and list all markets served; do not claim domestic Samoan consumer sales as purely offshore activity.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Economic Substance declaration certifying physical office, employees, and board meeting location in Samoa.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach supporting evidence (lease, employment records, board minutes) where relevant income is claimed; absence of substance triggers ESR penalties and back-assessment.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Annual Government Fee computation based on notional capital.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Pay the AGF in full by the anniversary; a nil income declaration does not waive the AGF.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing attracts a penalty of SAT 500 plus SAT 100 per month of delinquency; unpaid Annual Government Fee attracts a 10% late payment penalty and continued default leads to compulsory deregistration and strike-off of the IC within 6 to 12 months.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Corporate Income Tax Return (Form IRC-1) — lodged via the Samoa Revenue Authority (SRA) electronic filing portal; an exempt IC files the Nil / Exempt Income Declaration supplementary schedule.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within 6 months of the fiscal year-end (calendar-year taxpayers: due 30 June). Provisional tax installments apply only where any Samoan-source income exists and are due quarterly on 15 June, 15 September, 15 December, and 15 March.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) of the IC.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Register for a Samoan TIN with the SRA even where the IC claims full tax exemption; the TIN is required for tax clearance certificates and bank account opening.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Income year covered by the return.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State the fiscal year-end; align to the DTC brand's consolidated financial statements for consistent transfer-pricing documentation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total income reported in financial statements.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report worldwide gross sales from Shopify, PayPal, and Stripe settlement reports; attach a three-way reconciliation to avoid revenue omission flags.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exempt offshore income claimed under the IC regime.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Claim IC exemption only for income sourced outside Samoa; do not include sales to Samoan-resident consumers or income attributable to a Samoan permanent establishment.
Identify any DTC fulfillment or delivery into Samoa's customs territory, local warehousing, or a Samoan permanent establishment; such income is taxable at 27%.
Allocate expenses on an arm's-length basis; offshore IC overheads are not deductible against any Samoan-source assessable income.
Enter SAT 0 where Box E is nil; ensure supporting exemption certificate is retained on file.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Corporate income tax at 27% on Box G.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Compute only on positive Samoan-source taxable income; fully exempt ICs enter nil.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Credits, provisional tax paid, refund due or balance payable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Any shortfall attracts a monthly late-payment surcharge of 2%; claim refunds through the SRA electronic portal only after a completed audit trail.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: 20% of tax payable where a liability exists, or a fixed SAT 2,000 for nil returns; late payment: 2% monthly surcharge up to a 200% maximum; material misstatements above SAT 20,000 trigger evasion penalties up to 150% of the tax shortfall and potential criminal prosecution.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% for dividends paid by a Samoan International Company to non-resident shareholders; the statutory 15% dividend withholding tax under the Income Tax Act 2015 attaches only to distributions by resident companies and does not apply to exempt IC distributions.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke Double Taxation Agreement (DTA) relief, the recipient must (i) obtain a Tax Residence Certificate (TRC) from their country of tax residence, (ii) submit the TRC together with the IC exemption certificate, dividend voucher, and DTA application form to the Samoa Revenue Authority (SRA) before or within 60 days of the payment date, and (iii) rely on the Samoa-Australia DTA or the Samoa-New Zealand DTA where applicable. Processing takes 10 to 20 business days; where no TRC is filed within 60 days, the statutory resident-company rate of 15% may be withheld pending correction.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rates: 15% withholding on interest and 15% on royalties paid from Samoan sources; payments made by an exempt IC in respect of offshore operations attract 0%. Treaty rates under the Australia and New Zealand DTAs generally cap interest at 10% and royalties at 10-15%. Intercompany IP licensing from the IC to the Shopify brand must be documented under an arm's-length licence agreement to avoid recharacterization as a dividend or a sham arrangement.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: SAT 1,000,000 (approximately USD 37,000) of aggregated cross-border related-party transactions in an income year triggers mandatory contemporaneous Local File and Master File documentation; dedicated thresholds of SAT 500,000 apply to intercompany management fees and IP royalties, and the SRA may compel documentation below these thresholds in audit risk cases.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Samoa's Economic Substance Regulations apply to ICs deriving relevant income from banking, insurance, shipping, headquarters, holding, distribution, and service centre activities. A Shopify DTC brand routed through a Samoan IC must evidence: a physical registered-office presence in Samoa, at least one board meeting held in Samoa, adequate employees and expenditure commensurate with the functions performed, and an annual substance certification filed with the Registrar. The substance requirement fails where revenue is booked in Samoa but all decision-making, inventory control, and digital operations occur entirely outside the jurisdiction.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion - Fraudulent IC Exemption Claim
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Booking e-commerce revenue derived from Samoan-resident consumers, or income attributable to a Samoan permanent establishment, as 'exempt offshore income' while misrepresenting the location of fulfillment, inventory, and customers.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Assessment of the tax shortfall plus an evasion penalty of up to 150%, prosecution under section 73 of the Tax Administration Act 2015, imprisonment for up to 5 years, and publication of the taxpayer's name in the official list of tax defaulters.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally liable for the shortfall and penalties where they signed false returns; the SRA may impose travel bans via Departure Prohibition Orders, freeze bank accounts, and seize assets; directors face disqualification and criminal conviction where culpable knowledge is proven.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining a mailbox-only International Company with no physical office, staff, or board activity in Samoa while claiming IC tax benefits; failing to file the annual Economic Substance declaration or filing a materially false declaration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Economic Substance penalties up to SAT 200,000, compulsory strike-off of the IC, revocation of exempt status, and back-assessment of corporate income tax at 27% on up to 5 years of previously exempt income.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and ultimate beneficial owners are jointly and severally liable for back-taxes and penalty amounts; directors may be disqualified from acting as Samoan company officers for up to 10 years; the entity is flagged on international exchange-of-information registers, exposing shareholders to global enforcement.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the Samoan IC to layer or disguise Shopify, PayPal, or Stripe proceeds from high-risk transactions; concealing the true DTC brand owner behind nominee shareholders; failing to appoint a resident AML compliance officer or to maintain transaction records as required for financial service providers.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines of up to SAT 5 million and imprisonment of up to 14 years under the Samoa Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007 (as amended), mandatory forfeiture of proceeds, freezing of merchant accounts, and suspension of payment-rail settlement privileges.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Individual directors and beneficial owners face personal criminal conviction, asset forfeiture, travel bans, and extradition risk; the corporate veil is pierced where the IC is shown to be an instrument of fraud or money laundering.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Withholding Tax Evasion via Mischaracterized Distributions
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Recharacterizing dividend repatriations from the IC as 'management fees', 'service fees', or 'royalty payments' to foreign related parties in order to create artificial deductions or disguise profit extraction; engaging in conduit arrangements that lack commercial substance and expose treaty-shopping abuse.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: SRA deemed-dividend adjustments, penalty of 100% of the undeclared amount, monthly interest surcharge of 2%, and, in treaty contexts, denial of relief with additional fines of up to SAT 100,000 under the International Companies Act 1987.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally liable for conduit-company abuse, including repayment orders and recovery from personal estates; prohibition orders bar them from acting as officers of any Samoan company, and continued abuse risks criminal prosecution for tax fraud.
